name: Feinguss Allgäu-Reiter GmbH
summary: Feinguss Allgäu-Reiter is a family-owned investment foundry founded in 1962, with 160 staff and €24.1 M turnover. It casts our volute casing and impeller from Hollerau-owned tooling. The owner visited on 2026-09-24, recalled that in 2022 they held the old price for a quarter, and said he expects 'partnership in return'. That reads as groundwork for a price request before the contractual notice deadline (~2026-10-02). Meanwhile their delivery performance is slipping: OTD fell to 73.1 % against a 95 % target, and one 8D report is overdue.
negotiation_pattern: Opens modestly and accepts reductions. It asked roughly 0 % in the last two renewals and settled at -2.1 % and -3.0 %. In 2023 it asked -2.1 % and -5.1 % and settled at -3.7 % and -6.4 %. When it asked for increases (+1.5 % and +4.0 % in 2024), it settled at 0 %. On average it settles 2.26 pp below its ask. It does not fight hard on paper, but it keeps score: the owner now invokes past goodwill and expects reciprocity.
wants: on-time payment (we pay late in 91 % of cases, on average 4.1 days after due)
long-term volume security and contract continuity beyond 2027-06
stable price, no further cuts after three years of net reductions
protects: unit_price against further steep cuts (has given -2 to -6 % repeatedly; will dig in if pushed again)
dignity of the relationship: will not accept being benchmarked against a Chinese should-cost

trades.give: pay strictly on time; optionally shorten payment_days or add a small skonto
trades.get: price hold for 2027 (no increase) or a small reduction
trades.why: Our late payment is a concrete fairness grievance; fixing it is cheap goodwill for a family owner.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework (e.g. 24 months beyond 2027-06-30) and share a volume_per_year forecast
trades.get: unit_price hold or reduction plus a binding OTD recovery plan toward the 95 % target
trades.why: Long-term commitment is what 'partnership' means to an owner-led firm, and spend has grown every year.

trades.get: closure of the overdue 8D, an OTD commitment, and enforcement of the agreed €150/complaint chargeback (currently never recharged)
trades.why: Ties volume security to fixing the delivery slide without attacking price.

arguments.point: We have grown our business with them every year, from €584k to €751k to €799k, and want to keep doing so. That is the partnership we offer.
OTD has fallen to 73.1 % against a 95 % contractual target, and an 8D is overdue. Partnership works both ways, so a recovery plan is a precondition for any price discussion.
Prices are fixed per calendar year, and changes need written notice 90 days before year-end. Any 2027 increase not notified by about 2026-10-02 is out of time.
We acknowledge the 2022 goodwill explicitly. It costs nothing and matters to the owner.

avoid: Quoting the cost:310051 should-cost (+39.7 %). It models a different, Chinese plant at only 5 % confidence and would insult the owner.
Threatening re-sourcing or tooling transfer as an opener. Keep it as a last resort only.
Hard, impersonal percentage demands, or ignoring the 2022 gesture.
Raising our own late payment only when they raise it. Fix it proactively.
tone: Personal, respectful and long-term. Address the owner directly, acknowledge 2022, and be firm but fair on delivery performance.
red_flags: OTD trend is deteriorating (81.5 → 78.8 → 73.1 %), scorecard is back to amber, and one 8D is overdue.
A price-increase request is likely imminent, signalled by the owner's 'partnership in return' remark. Check whether written notice arrives before ~2026-10-02.
Equity ratio is 25 % and the credit index is 244 (stable, not weak). There is moderate rather than acute financial risk.
We are only 3.3 % of its turnover, so it could deprioritise us or walk away if treated badly.
Each part has only one alternative source. Tooling is ours, so switching is feasible but not quick.

evidence.claim: Family-owned GmbH, founded 1962, 160 staff, turnover €24.1 M, equity ratio 25 %, credit index 244 unchanged over 12 months
The owner visited on 2026-09-24, reminded us of the 2022 price hold for a quarter and expects partnership in return
Settled below its ask in every renewal: -2.1 % (ask 0 %) and -3.0 % (ask +0.1 %) for 2026; 0 % against asks of +1.5 % / +4 % for 2025
OTD 73.1 % with one overdue 8D, amber, against a contractual 95 % target and €150/complaint chargeback
Price changes need written notice 90 days before calendar year-end; the framework runs to 2027-06-30 with automatic 12-month extension
Hollerau owns the tooling for both parts, each part has one other source, and quotas are 75 % and 60 %
The impeller price of 118.73 is 39.7 % above a should-cost of 84.97, but that estimate models a Chinese plant (sup:70160) at 5 % confidence

indicators.credit_index: 244 (12 months ago 244; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 amber (otd 79.6, ppm 1106) → 2026Q1 green (otd 81.5, ppm 542) → 2026Q2 green (otd 78.8, ppm 539) → 2026Q3 amber (otd 73.1, ppm 526)
